periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45 degrees oblique relative to the horizontal facial axis, oriented towards the muzzle.

periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Clear downward tapering is visible, shifting the lowest point of the patch medially towards the snout.
